devdoc.details: Inside a Hedera contract, HBAR amounts (`msg.value`, balances) are tinybars, 8 decimals.      Clients send weibars, 18 decimals, and the JSON-RPC relay converts between them.      This contract deliberately does **not** check KYC, freeze or pause status. Those rules      belong to the token and the network applies them during step 2. Checking here as well      would fail earlier but is not the guarantee, and it invites the belief that the network's      check is redundant. A frontend may pre-check to show a friendlier message.

params.buyer: The account that paid and received the asset.
params.settlementPaid: Settlement-token base units paid to the issuer.

associateAsset().details: The issuer must also grant this contract KYC before sending it inventory, otherwise      the inventory transfer itself is refused with 176.

buy(int64,uint256).details: `msg.value` is the buyer's maximum spend, not the price: the router takes what the      trade costs and the rest comes back.

params.deadline: Unix timestamp after which the quote is no longer honoured.

params.asset_: The permissioned HTS asset to sell.
params.issuerTreasury_: Settlement recipient; the `evm_address` for an aliased account.
params.pricePerUnit_: Settlement base units per asset unit.
params.settlementToken_: The token the issuer is paid in.

quote(int64).details: A quote is only good for the reserves it was read at. `buy` re-prices at execution and      is bounded by `msg.value`, so a stale quote costs the buyer nothing beyond fees.

returns.settlementAmount: Settlement base units the issuer would receive.

sweepHbar(address).details: A completed purchase leaves no HBAR behind, but Hedera does not run `receive()` on a      native CryptoTransfer, so HBAR can still arrive without passing the guard below.      Without this it would be stranded.

withdrawInventory(address,int64).details: Without this the asset is stranded in an abandoned sale. The recipient must be      associated with the asset and hold KYC, or the network refuses with 184 or 176.

devdoc.title: SanadSale

AssociationFailed(int64).notice: The contract could not associate itself with the asset.

DeliveryFailed(int64).notice: The network refused to deliver the asset, so the whole purchase is reverted.         176 KYC not granted, 165 account frozen, 184 not associated, 265 token paused.

InvalidAmount().notice: Units must be positive; the price must not be zero.

NotOwner().notice: Caller is not the issuer operations account.

NothingToSweep().notice: There is no HBAR to recover.

QuoteExpired(uint256,uint256).notice: The quote was no longer valid when the transaction reached consensus.

Reentrancy().notice: A nested call into a guarded function.

RefundFailed().notice: Forwarding HBAR to the buyer failed, so the purchase is reverted.

SweepFailed().notice: Sending HBAR to the recipient failed.

UnexpectedHbarSender(address).notice: Only the router's refund may reach `receive()`.

WithdrawalFailed(int64).notice: The network refused to move inventory out.

AssetAssociated(address).notice: The contract associated itself with the asset so it can hold inventory.

HbarSwept(address,uint256).notice: HBAR that arrived outside a purchase was recovered.

HTS().notice: The Hedera Token Service system contract.

associateAsset().notice: Associates this contract with the asset so it can hold sale inventory.

buy(int64,uint256).notice: Buys `units` of the asset, paying in HBAR.

issuerTreasury().notice: Where settlement lands. For an ECDSA account this must be its `evm_address`: HTS refuses transfers to the long-zero address of an aliased account with INVALID_ALIAS_KEY (282).

owner().notice: The issuer operations account. Set once, at construction, and never transferable.

pricePerUnit().notice: Settlement-token base units charged per one asset unit.

quote(int64).notice: The HBAR the pool currently requires for `units`, and the settlement it produces.

router().notice: The SaucerSwap V1 router used for the HBAR to settlement-token leg.

settlementToken().notice: The token the issuer is paid in.

sweepHbar(address).notice: Recovers HBAR held by this contract.

whbarToken().notice: The WHBAR **token**, read from the router at construction. Swap paths start here.

withdrawInventory(address,int64).notice: Moves unsold inventory out of the contract.

userdoc.notice: Sells units of a permissioned HTS asset for HBAR, in one transaction:         1. SaucerSwap V1 converts the buyer's HBAR into exactly the settlement amount and pays            the issuer's treasury directly.         2. This contract delivers the asset from its own inventory.         3. The router's refund of unused HBAR is forwarded to the buyer.         If step 2 is refused, step 1 is undone with it. There is no state in which the buyer         has paid and not been served.
